scope: Post list page (`/`) and post detail page (`/posts/[slug]`) behaviour.
Gist API client: fetch metadata and file content.
Markdown rendering: conversion of post content to HTML.
Configuration: Gist ID(s) from env/config and post source resolution.
Navigation: list item click → post view; back link → list.
environmentData: **Build:** `bun run build` must succeed before running tests.
**Environment variables:** `GIST_ID` or equivalent config for Gist source (mocked in tests).
**Fixtures:** Sample Gist metadata and Markdown content for deterministic unit/integration tests.
## User Story: US-001 - View List of Posts

automatedTests.description: Gist client fetches metadata from configured Gist ID
Config resolves Gist ID from env/config
Post list component displays title and preview/date for each post
Post list is ordered by date (newest first)
Gist client fetches file content by slug
Markdown renderer converts content to HTML
Post detail page displays post title
Post has title and body derived from Gist
Back link or navigation returns to list
Gist fetch failure shows explicit error state
Invalid or missing Gist ID yields graceful fallback
Markdown with code blocks renders code element
Markdown with links renders anchor elements

exploratoryManualTests.description: Post list page renders correctly in browser
Full post page renders correctly in browser
